title: Minestrone (Knife-Skills Lesson)
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, small dice
steps: Cut every vegetable to an even 1/4-inch dice before you turn on the stove.
Sweat the onion, carrot and celery in the oil 10 minutes without browning.
Add the rest except the pasta; simmer 20 minutes, then add the pasta for 10.

videos.title: Jacques Pépin Techniques: Proper Knife Skills for Cutting, Chopping and Slicing
videos.why: Watch how he grips the knife at the blade and curls his guiding fingers so his knuckles steer the cut, then squares off vegetables for even dice.
